msg: RULING hook-local amendment (ADR 0026 rule 6): with TIC_STORE=git, a tic whose FROM is a hook identity (subagent, run-suite, guard, witness — the single HOOK_IDENTITIES list, drift-guarded against tic.sh:14) always goes to the LOCAL jsonl store, never to git, makes no network call and takes no lock; agent tics still publish. Readers already union jsonl+git, so tics gate/cycle still see run-suite signals locally. Pins: a hook-identity emit under TIC_STORE=git creates no bus commit, spawns no git network process and returns < 200 ms; an agent emit right after still publishes; tics gate on a git-store install still counts the hook-signed green. Then the dogfood config may come back.
